Budesonide and sodium sulfate/potassium chloride/magnesium sulfate/polyethylene glycol can both reduce serum potassium levels. Therapy should be modified, and potassium levels should be closely monitored. 2. Budesonide reduces the levels or effects of solifenacin by altering hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzyme metabolism. Therapy should be modified, and CYP3A4 substrates co-administered with stiripentol should be monitored for increased or decreased effects. 7. Stiripentol increases the levels or effects of budesonide by inhibiting P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter activity. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. Consider reducing the dose of P-glycoprotein substrates if adverse reactions occur. 8.
